items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: And he was playing with Sidney Desveen, see? I used to go down there and listen to them

ctx.x: He told us about Sidney Desveen's band, or just what it was like when you played with him?

Sidney, yeah, when I, well, as you know, when I was a boy learning how to play music, at that time it was customary for the band to practice in houses at that time, see? And like, I mean, like today you say, well, I go to the union and they got a special place for bands to work. Well, it wasn't like that at that time. Everybody used to practice in the front room, see? Well, Sidney Desveen was living in the next block from my house, but I used to go down there and listen to their band play, and Earl Bostic was…
I mean, did he use all arrangements or did they have, uh...
